purpose: Playbook-heterogeneous corpus to fairly test Oscillitron's Thread A router (routes on operation, not subject). See README.md and scratch/dense-router-design.md §2.12.9.
notes: Iteration 1 seed: 4 verified tasks per playbook across 12 domains, plus a 3-per-action seed exemplar store. Each (playbook x domain) cell is intentionally varied so the router must route on the operation axis. Subsequent iterations grow toward target and raise verification_passes.
